# Veklom Control Plane

Veklom is the Sovereign AI Hub. It allows you to test, plan, govern, deploy, and prove private AI from one tenant-scoped workspace.

## Documentation
- API Docs: https://veklom.com/docs
- OpenAPI Spec: https://veklom.com/openapi.json

## Features
- Agentic Governance
- API Benchmarking
- Runtime Authority
- Physics-based SLAs
- Nexus Protocol & x402
